name: Yamamoto (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Yamamoto town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Yamamoto, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 November 1985; the emblem dates from 3 November 1964.

features.role: Yamamoto town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a stylised character
